stations.name: SomaFM Drone Zone
stations.descriptionRo: Muzica terapeutica ambient fara ritm, texturi calde ce reduc cortizolul si anxietatea nervoasa.
stations.descriptionEn: Therapeutic beat-free ambient soundscapes that soothe the nervous system and lower cortisol.

stations.name: Ambient Sleeping Pill
stations.descriptionRo: Armonii hipnotice continue compuse special pentru eliberarea tensiunii acumulate si relaxare profunda.
stations.descriptionEn: Hypnotic continuous ambient harmonies designed for total mental release and de-stressing.

stations.name: YourClassical Relax
stations.descriptionRo: Piese acustice clasice si nocturne delicate pentru calmarea mintii si echilibru psiho-emotional.
stations.descriptionEn: Delicate acoustic classical tones for calming the active mind and emotional restoration.

stations.name: SomaFM Deep Space One
stations.descriptionRo: Stream legendar de meditatie spatiala profunda, boluri tibetane si armonici plutitoare.
stations.descriptionEn: Legendary deep ambient station with spacious acoustics, singing bowls, and meditative pads.

stations.name: Stereoscenic Modern Ambient
stations.descriptionRo: Texturi luminoase calde pentru prezenta constienta, introspectie si liniste interioara.
stations.descriptionEn: Warm contemplative atmospheric textures for mindfulness, reflection, and quiet presence.

stations.name: SomaFM Suburbs of Goa
stations.descriptionRo: Sitar acustic, flaut de bambus si mantre orientale delicate pentru meditatie profunda.
stations.descriptionEn: Acoustic sitar, bamboo flute, and gentle Eastern textures for transformative meditation.

stations.name: SomaFM Sleep's Dark Web
stations.descriptionRo: Peisaje sonore nocturne catifelate ce opresc ruminatia gandurilor si induc somnul REM sanatos.
stations.descriptionEn: Velvety nocturnal soundscapes designed to quiet racing thoughts and induce restorative sleep.

stations.name: SomaFM Space Station
stations.descriptionRo: Ecouri hipnotice plutitoare ideale pentru trecerea lina catre starea de repaus nocturn.
stations.descriptionEn: Hypnotic floating echoes ideal for drifting effortlessly into unbroken deep sleep.

stations.name: SomaFM Mission Control
stations.descriptionRo: Ambient spatial combinat cu frecvente Theta si transmisiuni astronautice relaxante.
stations.descriptionEn: Spacious ambient paired with Theta rhythms and soothing astronaut broadcasts.

stations.name: SomaFM Fluid Instrumental
stations.descriptionRo: Melodii suave de pian si acustica delicata ce reproduc atmosfera unui centru spa exclusivist.
stations.descriptionEn: Gentle piano and fluid acoustic textures reproducing the peaceful luxury of a wellness spa.

stations.name: SomaFM Groove Salad
stations.descriptionRo: Cel mai apreciat stream de chillout lent pentru masaj, eliberarea tensiunii corporale si Reiki.
stations.descriptionEn: World-famous gentle downtempo stream for massage, bodywork, and holistic rebalancing.

stations.name: Nature Radio Rain HD
stations.descriptionRo: Sunet autentic de ploaie calda de padure si tunete indepartate de mare fidelitate.
stations.descriptionEn: Authentic warm forest rain and distant rolling thunder in crystal-clear fidelity.

stations.name: MyNoise Pure Nature
stations.descriptionRo: Paduri virgine, ciripit de pasari si freamatul vantului printre crengi, captate pe viu.
stations.descriptionEn: Pristine wild forests, authentic birdsong, and gentle breezes recorded in natural reserves.

stations.name: Ambi Nature River & Forest
stations.descriptionRo: Izvoare de munte cristaline si brize linistitoare pentru lucru fara stres si relaxare.
stations.descriptionEn: Crystal-clear mountain streams and gentle forest breezes for calm and focus.

stations.name: Radio Nature Sanctuary
stations.descriptionRo: Sanctuar sonor complet cu valuri oceanice blande si peisaje acustice naturale neintrerupte.
stations.descriptionEn: Complete sound sanctuary featuring ocean shores, wind, and non-stop natural tranquility.
